_: Commander rows for which the book gives no Ld value in the row's heading or in the row's own text. Page + verified, as in options.json. build_data.py fails the build if a commander lacks both a parsed and an acknowledged leadership. rerolls_scope / rerolls_unit (5.10.2026): the book's own limit on the included re-roll - whose rolls it may be used on, or that it is per turn. A short English phrase that the app prints after the number; the book's sentence is in the why field.

commanders.label: Lord Admiral Rath (Ld10)
commanders.why: p.48: 'Admirals get one Fleet Commander re-roll included in their points cost (Lord Admiral Rath has two)' and 'Lord Admiral Rath is Ld 10 and comes with two re-rolls as part of his point cost'. The section's general sentence would give one (spot check 9 row 38).

commanders.label: Space Marine Captain
commanders.why: p.100: no Ld value; 'Space Marine Captains roll against the Space Marines leadership table instead of the normal leadership table'. The card's LEADERSHIP is left to be filled in by hand.

commanders.label: Farseers
commanders.why: p.318: 'gives the vessel a re-roll which may be used on itself, another capital ship in the same squadron or an escort squadron within 15 cm'; no Ld value. The limit from the same sentence: 'may be used on itself, another capital ship in the same squadron or an escort squadron within 15 cm'.
commanders.rerolls_scope: own ship, its squadron or an escort squadron within 15 cm

commanders.label: Prince Yriel
commanders.why: p.319: 'He has one re-roll as part of his point cost, but a second or third re-roll can be purchased at +25 points each'; no Ld value is given (taken in place of the Hero).

commanders.label: Ordo Xenos Inquisitor Lord
commanders.why: p.141: 'The ship adds +1 to its leadership (max. 10).' The sentence is missing from the extracted section text (lists.py), so it is recorded here from the book; the Hereticus (p.140) and the Malleus (p.142) parse from their own text.

commanders.label: Abaddon (Ld 10)
